name: Bella Vista Bistro
description: Bella Vista Bistro is an award-winning neighborhood cafe offering specialty single-origin coffees, handcrafted Italian pastas, wood-fired artisanal pizzas, and Mediterranean plates prepared with locally sourced organic ingredients.
parking_info: Complimentary 2-hour parking available in the attached subterranean garage on 4th Street. Valet service available on Friday and Saturday evenings from 6:00 PM.
cancellation_policy: Reservations can be cancelled or modified free of charge up to 2 hours prior to reservation time. For parties larger than 6 guests, we appreciate 4 hours notice.
